# VELIX

> VELIX is a web development and digital solutions company that designs and builds modern websites, web applications, e-commerce platforms, and software solutions.

VELIX focuses on creating fast, modern, scalable, and user-friendly digital experiences for businesses.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://velixweb.vercel.app/): Overview of VELIX and its digital development services.
- [About](https://velixweb.vercel.app/about): Information about VELIX.
- [Services](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services): Overview of VELIX services.
- [Projects](https://velixweb.vercel.app/projects): VELIX projects and portfolio.
- [Industries](https://velixweb.vercel.app/industries): Industries and business areas served by VELIX.
- [Process](https://velixweb.vercel.app/process): VELIX development process.
- [Pricing](https://velixweb.vercel.app/pricing): Pricing and service information.
- [Insights](https://velixweb.vercel.app/insights): Articles, guides, and technical insights.
- [Contact](https://velixweb.vercel.app/contact): Contact VELIX.

## Services

- [Custom Web Development](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/custom-web-development): Custom website development.
- [React.js Development](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/react-js-development): React.js development services.
- [Next.js Development](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/next-js-development): Next.js development services.
- [Web Application Development](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/web-application-development): Web application development.
- [E-commerce Development](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/e-commerce-development): E-commerce website and platform development.
- [WordPress Development](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/wordpress-development): WordPress development services.
- [UI/UX Design](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/ui-ux-design): User interface and user experience design.
- [API Development & Integration](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/api-development-integration): API development and third-party integrations.
- [Website Maintenance](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/website-maintenance): Ongoing website maintenance and support.
- [Website Performance Optimization](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/website-performance-optimization): Website speed and performance optimization.
- [SEO](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/seo): Search engine optimization services.
- [Mobile App Development](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/mobile-app-development): Mobile application development.
- [Software Development](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/software-development): Custom software development.
- [CMS Development](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/cms-development): Content management system development.
- [Shopify Development](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/shopify-development): Shopify development services.
- [Cloud Hosting](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/cloud-hosting): Cloud hosting and deployment solutions.
- [Digital Marketing](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/digital-marketing): Digital marketing services.
- [AI Integration](https://velixweb.vercel.app/services/ai-integration): AI integration for websites and applications.
